news.forms module

Forms for registration, articles, newsletters and subscriptions.

class news.forms.RegistrationForm(*args, **kwargs)[source]

Bases: UserCreationForm

Public sign-up form.

role is deliberately not a field, so every new account is a reader and nobody can register as an editor or journalist.

news.forms.publisher_choices(user)[source]

Return the publishers user may file content under.

Journalists see publishers they belong to; editors also see the publishers they edit for.
